subject: Supply chain proofing: Subprocessor handoff runbook and evidence phases
messages:
From: Greg Turner <gt@novushealth.com>
To: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Asha Kapoor <security@novushealth.com>
Date: Sun, 5 Oct 2025 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request: consolidated subprocessor manifest + evidence staging for SOC 2 / SIG review

Connor,

Thanks for taking this — Novus is starting the next phase of a security review tied to our SOC 2 renewal and we need a compact handoff from Redwood that maps your runtime and infra third parties to the evidence items we request in SIG/CAIQ. Specifically we need:

- A single CSV manifest listing every subprocessor, role (e.g. infra, telemetry, KMS, observability), region of operation, residency claims, and data access level.
- For each roster entry, one pointer to the primary evidence artifact (SOC2 report excerpt, attestation, CAIQ mapping, or encryption custody note).
- A short runbook (1–2 pages) describing how Redwood partitions ephemeral KV cache keys and how KMS custody is separated between hosted/dedicated/private deployments.

Timing: can you provide the manifest + index next week (by Oct 12)? We will then ask a few follow-ups for attestation PDFs or deeper control excerpts.

Also note: our procurement team will want to see the residency guarantees for EU and APAC-hosted vendors.

Appreciate it — we want to keep this tight to avoid extra back-and-forth during the audit.

Thanks,
Greg Turner
Head of Security Programs
Novus Health

From: Connor O'Brien <connor.obrien@redwoodinference.com>
To: Greg Turner <gt@novushealth.com>
Cc: Asha Kapoor <security@novushealth.com>, Naomi Feldman <naomi_feldman@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Sun, 5 Oct 2025 13:27:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request: consolidated subprocessor manifest + evidence staging for SOC 2 / SIG review

Greg — thanks for the clear ask. Attached is a scoped delivery plan and an initial manifest export to get started. High-level plan: 

Phase 0 (Today — Oct 6): quick inventory + doc index (we're sending a CSV + evidence index PDF attached).
Phase 1 (Oct 7–12): populate primary artifacts and CAIQ crosswalk for your critical vendors (KMS, caching, telemetry, infra).
Phase 2 (Oct 13–20): deliver SOC2 excerpts and onshore residency confirmations; supply PDFs or signed attestations as available.

Key notes and constraints:
- For Dedicated and Private customers we have separate KMS residency/delegation docs; we'll call those out explicitly in the manifest rows.
- Some vendors (edge telemetry) have time-limited access attestations — we'll flag those as "temporal" in the manifest so you can scope what to include in the auditor packet.

Attachments (stubs included with this message):
- redwood_subprocessor_manifest_v1.csv (CSV: name, service_role, region, data_access, residency_claim, primary_evidence_id)
- evidence_index_v1.pdf (index mapping evidence ids to doc stubs and status: available/partial/requested)
- subproc-handoff-runbook-draft.md (runbook draft: separation of duties, KMS pathing, ephemeral KV cache behavior)

Next steps I propose:
1) We deliver the attached manifest + index now (attached).
2) Naomi will produce the CAIQ crosswalk for KMS + telemetry by Oct 9.
3) Ben will pull custody and attestation PDFs for KMS and the top three infra vendors by Oct 12.

If that timeline works, we'll update HubSpot and share a Drive folder link with the artifacts.

Connor O'Brien
Security & Compliance — Redwood Inference
(attachment: redwood_subprocessor_manifest_v1.csv, evidence_index_v1.pdf, subproc-handoff-runbook-draft.md)
